[NeruIPS 2024] Lips Are Lying: Spotting the Temporal Inconsistency between Audio and Visual in Lip-syncing DeepFakes
	





Abstract.  In recent years, DeepFake technology has achieved unprecedented success in high-quality video synthesis, but these methods also pose potential and severe security threats to humanity. DeepFake can be bifurcated into entertainment applications like face swapping and illicit uses such as lip-syncing fraud.
